acts.title: ACT ONE: A Perfectly Normal Week
acts.card: Good evening. I am the Narrator. I have narrated four thousand comics, and not one of them has ever had a twist. Please keep your hands, paws and lamps inside the margins.

acts.title: ACT TWO: Things Get Out of Hand
acts.card: Act Two. I have spoken to my lawyer. My lawyer says lamps cannot be sued. My lawyer is also a lamp now. I don't want to talk about it.

acts.title: ACT THREE: Lights Out
acts.card: Act Three. No more Mister Nice Narrator. I know where the fuse box is.

exit_places: the horoscopes. He's a Scorpio now
